dialect.detail: Likely Micro Focus COBOL or compatible (e.g., GnuCOBOL) targeting a character-mode screen application; French-language program with box-drawing characters in comments, DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, ACCEPT/DISPLAY with LINE/POSITION/SIZE/CONTROL clauses typical of Micro Focus screen I/O extensions
evidence: ACCEPT ... LINE ... POSITION ... SIZE ... TAB UPDATE NO BEEP CURSOR

purpose.domain_detail: Candidate/personnel search application — likely part of an HR or staffing management system. French-language ('RECHERCHE CANDIDATS' = candidate search).
purpose.summary: This program (2-CANDID) implements a candidate search/browse screen. It reads candidate records via a called subprogram (6-CANDID), displays them on a character-mode screen with person details (name, birth date, start/end dates), and allows the user to select a candidate by number or matchcode. It handles paging, function-key navigation, and returns the selected candidate record to the caller.

notable_features: REDEFINES used for multi-length numeric input parsing (CHOIX-A1 through CHOIX-A6)
OCCURS array HE-REG for storing displayed record keys
INSPECT TALLYING for input length detection
LINKAGE SECTION with PROCEDURE DIVISION USING
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1; box-drawing characters in comments suggest CP850 encoding (French DOS/Windows environment). The program is part of a larger multi-program system (calls 6-CANDID, 6-PERSON, 4-PRNOM). Dialect is ambiguous between Micro Focus and GnuCOBOL; the screen I/O extensions and CONTROL clause are consistent with both. No long lines over 72 columns confirms fixed format.
